transaction_extraction.task: Extract transaction data from Agricultural Bank of China (ABC) account history

column_descriptions.收入金额: 收入金额，无数据则为 0 或空
column_descriptions.支出金额: 支出金额，无数据则为 0 或空
column_descriptions.对方开户行: 对方的开户银行，如 '中国农业银行股份有限公司青岛市北第三支行'
column_descriptions.摘要: 交易摘要，如 '转存'、'转取'、'费用外收'、'贷款还款'

extraction_rules: Skip header rows containing column names
Skip footer summary rows (总收入笔数, 总支出笔数 etc.)
交易时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
收入金额和支出金额二选一有值
对方开户行可能跨多行显示，需合并
Keep original amount format with decimal places
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

summary_extraction.task: Extract summary information from Agricultural Bank of China account history
summary_extraction.location: Summary info is split: header info at top of first page (账号、户名、币种、起止日期), footer info at bottom of last page (总收入/支出笔数/金额)

target_fields.账号: Account number, like '38-07580104000011', found in page header
target_fields.户名: Account holder name, found in page header
target_fields.币种: Currency type, like '人民币', found in page header
target_fields.起止日期: Date range, like '2023年09月22日 - 2024年04月27日', found in page header
target_fields.总收入笔数: Total income transaction count, found at bottom of last page
target_fields.总收入金额: Total income amount, found at bottom of last page
target_fields.总支出笔数: Total expense transaction count, found at bottom of last page
target_fields.总支出金额: Total expense amount, found at bottom of last page

extraction_rules: Header fields: 账号 after '账号:', 户名 after '户名:', 币种 after '币种:', 起止日期 after '起止日期:'
Footer fields are in a summary row at the bottom of the last page
Footer format: 总收入笔数 X 总收入金额 Y 总支出笔数 Z 总支出金额 W
If extracting from first page, footer fields may be empty
If extracting from last page, header fields will repeat - use them
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
